notes: The embedded Sanity Studio has a distinct CSP and must remain functional.
The 307 apex redirect is baseline-driven: preserve observed production behavior rather than an unseen app-level intention.
The canonical /impressum redirect is in verify.routes so source and workers.dev candidate are compared directly.
Image probes exercise both original static bytes and Next.js /_next/image so a missing Cloudflare Images binding cannot pass candidate verification.
POST /api/inquiry and POST /api/uploads require safe project-specific probes in addition to generic GET equivalence.
